step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture represents a serverless geospatial processing pipeline built by AC3 for New South Wales Spatial Services. 1. A developer (UserConsumerDeveloper) submits a GeoTIFF request through API Gateway to store the file in Amazon S3. 2. S3 sends the GeoTIFF to a Third-Party Provider for conversion into a LandXML file, which is written back into S3. 3. S3 event notifications trigger AWS Step Functions when LandXML lands in a specific folder structure. 4. Step Functions orchestrates two parallel Lambda functions: Lambda Validation (checking XML format and standard compliance) and Lambda Render (drawing polygons in memory using Python geospatial libraries). 5. Lambda Render writes execution results and state metadata to Amazon DynamoDB. 6. DynamoDB updates trigger Amazon SNS to alert users of progress or validation failures.

graph.name: AC3 Serverless Geospatial Data Lake Validation Architecture
graph.notes: Automates conversion of GeoTIFF files into LandXML and validates geospatial polygons using a serverless architecture.

nodes.name: Developer
nodes.notes: Submits GeoTIFF development applications to the system.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: Serves as the entry point for developer upload requests.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Stores original GeoTIFF files and incoming LandXML converted files.

nodes.name: Third-Party Provider
nodes.notes: Converts GeoTIFF files into LandXML format containing geospatial information.

nodes.name: Step Functions
nodes.notes: Orchestrates parallel validation workflows triggered by S3 folder events.

nodes.name: Lambda Validation
nodes.notes: Checks if the file is valid XML and conforms to current LandXML schema.

nodes.name: Lambda Render
nodes.notes: Forms polygons using lightweight Python geospatial libraries in memory.

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Stores validation results and multi-version document lifecycle state.

nodes.name: SNS
nodes.notes: Sends alerts and notifications regarding processing status or errors.

edges.notes: API Gateway writes GeoTIFF file to S3.
S3 triggers/sends GeoTIFF to Third-Party Provider for conversion.
Third-Party Provider returns converted LandXML file back to S3.
S3 file upload triggers Step Functions execution upon arrival.
Step Functions invokes Lambda Validation function.
Step Functions invokes Lambda Render function.
Lambda Render writes validation and polygon results to DynamoDB.
DynamoDB triggers SNS notifications based on state changes or errors.
